title: Projection-specific population information in parietal cortex
scientific_question: Do projection-defined PPC populations exhibit the reported information-enhancing/limiting interaction structure, beyond individual-neuron, behavioral and sampling explanations?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: Specialized structure of neural population codes in parietal cortex outputs

data.access: 70 files are individually unrestricted; fileAccessRequest=true is repository configuration, not a restriction on these files.
data.representation: Released session archives of neural/behavioral analysis data; no raw imaging required if released deconvolved activity and labels map completely.

official_code.license: Unresolved: GitHub license endpoint returned 404; no license inferred.
official_code.availability: Public commit and README verified. README describes NPvC and simulation code with bundled glmnet; complete real-data figure pipeline not established.
official_code.publication_identity: Current pinned commit; historical identity unproven.

complete_scope: All 70 released data files and all paper-defined eligible populations, with ACC, RSC, contralateral PPC and unlabeled groups retained. Reproduce the full choice-information/motif claim across all source-defined sessions and both outcome conditions, not only selected triplets.

outputs: Population-size information curves and information-enhancing/limiting motif summaries
Projection-group and correct/error contrasts with original uncertainty plus animal-grouped sensitivity
reference.panel: Figures 2–6; exact numeric panel-to-file mapping is a pre-admission blocker.

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Improved held-trial predictive log likelihood/FDE with maintained calibration, then test whether projection-specific motif conclusions survive held-animal and movement-controlled analysis.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Whole trials within session for model reproduction; whole mouse for generalization, with grouped uncertainty. Animal IDs must be recovered before accepting the latter.
controls: Rate and distance matched projection comparisons
Pair-preserving versus fully shuffled correlation nulls
Equal trial counts for correct/error analysis without dropping the complete original-cohort report

resources.basis: 14.98 GB compressed release plus complete extraction/features; kernel/copula dependence fits and population resampling can dominate. No measured timing.

remaining_gates: Real-data pipeline and complete panel mapping beyond simulation README
Finite complete population-size and resampling workload without silently truncating combinatorial analysis
overlap: No exact paper/code/data identity found in the finite 220 registry or six unregistered dossiers; broader population-information topics are not treated as duplicate identities.
participant_inputs: All70 released session files with trial-aligned neural responses, stimulus/task/behavior variables, projection identities and source eligibility. Raw imaging is unnecessary only if complete released analysis signals and their provenance satisfy every required panel.

machine_output.predictions: Per held trial/neuron or declared population size, predictive distributions/rates on the exact response grid with model and fold identity.
machine_output.tables: Figure2 FDE, Figures3–6 information curves and interaction/motif estimates; all projection groups, correct/error trials, population sizes and animal/session outcomes; numerical data underlying plots and uncertainty.
machine_output.artifacts: Frozen fitted models, training identities, complete null/control outputs and source-defined estimator/config manifest.

scoring: Recompute published FDE/information estimators and held-trial predictive log likelihood, then grouped projection contrasts. Exact estimator normalization and panel-to-file map must be source-bound before running. No triplet count is an independent animal sample.
protected_split: Original trial splits for reproduction; independent whole-mouse generalization where authentic IDs permit. TRAIN-only normalization/interaction fitting and inner grouped DEV selection; no held-label triplet selection.
comparators: NPvC, GLM, independent-neuron and source-defined interaction shuffles; movement/task-only predictors and rate/distance-matched contrasts. Preserve complete cohort alongside equal-trial sensitivity.
distinctness: Projection-specific population interaction and information structure; neither a cosmetic decoder variant nor an existing same-paper task.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
